name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: inline-thinking
plugins.description: Draws Claude's thinking in the chat, above the reply or tool call it led to, in place of the folded "Thought for 4s".

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Gates that refuse risky Bash commands (pkill, kill by pattern, git add -A, git commit -a) and tell Claude why and what to run instead.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Memories Claude writes for every project, kept in ~/.claude/memory and loaded into each session, and /global-memory, a menu to browse, read and delete them.

plugins.name: global-rules
plugins.description: Writes and maintains your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md: /global-rules:suggest turns your session history, corrections and memories into rules for it, and writes only the rules you approve.

plugins.name: github-tracking
plugins.description: Keeps a repo's GitHub issues, milestones and Projects board true while Claude works: each change starts from an issue on the board, larger steps split into sub-issues, and status updates say where the project stands.

plugins.name: screen-polish
plugins.description: Polishes Claude Code's terminal: inline code on a background, distinct heading levels, drawn rules, task-list checkboxes and quote bars in replies, plus optional tool-call rows, prompt marker and spinner words. Each turns on or off in /config.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: /bug-hunt:hunt finds bugs and reproduces each one before calling it a bug: a whole codebase component by component, a path or area, or a change that Claude Code's /code-review reviews first.

plugins.name: project-md
plugins.description: /project-md:init drafts PROJECT.md, a committed document that says what a project is for and what it won't do, and loads it into every session, with no line in CLAUDE.md. Run /project-md:review any time to check the work against it; it changes only what you approve.
